title: Mario Kart 64 in VR is not for the queasy - Engadget
summary: BeardoBenjo's post includes a clip of the game's Koopa Troopa Beach track, and a (fairly nauseating) first-person, head-tracked view of its tunnel shortcut. The Mario Kart 64 mod is based on an existing PC port of the racing game called SpaghettiKart .
